description: Read-only finance and accounting operations for evidence-labeled cash-flow, budget, invoice, payment, expense, close, and runway briefs from approved Odoo snapshots.

routing.when_to_use: Use for a read-only finance operations brief from an approved, synthetic or redacted Odoo snapshot and contract.
when_not_to_use: Do not invoke Odoo, an MCP/API connector, or any external service
Do not mutate accounting records or claim tax, legal, audit, or statutory finality
Do not process credentials, customer data, or private company records

required_inputs.name: approved_snapshot
required_inputs.description: Consumer-supplied Odoo snapshot with contract, period, currency, digest, source owner, and read operations

required_inputs.name: requested_views
required_inputs.description: One or more requested read-only finance operations views

expected_outputs.name: finance_operations_brief
expected_outputs.description: Evidence-labeled observations, assumptions, risks, and typed approval boundary

forbidden_actions: Invoke Odoo or an external connector
Create, update, post, approve, reconcile, or close an accounting record
Copy credentials, private records, or customer identifiers into release artifacts
verification_steps: Validate the approved Odoo contract, snapshot digest, period, currency, and source references
Validate the finance operations output schema and empty effects declaration
Return PENDING_APPROVAL for missing, stale, conflicting, private, or mutation-requested evidence
completion_criteria: Canonical Skill Pack and execution profile are schema-valid
Required evidence and provenance are preserved without external effects
No private data or credentials are retained
known_limitations: The consumer adapter owns transport, credentials, tenancy, endpoint mapping, and all mutations
A completed brief is not tax, legal, audit, statutory, or accounting-final authority
